evidence: NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_semantic_eval 14/14 passed; mypy --disallow-untyped-defs on palimnex/semantic_eval.py is clean; implementation-receipt validator status valid.

NOTE: PROMOTION_POLICY is exactly limit 5, min_mrr_gain 0.02, min_recall_gain 0.02, min_additional_passes 1, max_p95_multiplier 1.5, gain_rule mrr_or_recall; the evaluation schema pins those consts. COHORT_SHA256 equals cohort-freeze.json and the frozen file digest bfaa3998bc8c8ae5d05959f51e71aae08bf14f339a55fc0924d7e0b7b9ef4200. A modified cohort is refused with fixture_digest_mismatch; the evaluator did not edit the frozen file.

NOTE: R15 uses one shared memo, one discarded warmup, three measured repetitions, baseline-first on even reps and semantic-first on odd reps, nearest-rank p95, and an injected clock_ns. Real evaluation samples_per_variant was 78 (26 repository cases times 3). benchmark=False sets latency_within_bound false, adds benchmark_not_run, and forces status held.

NOTE: Read-only real evaluation on a /tmp copy returned status held with held_reasons cohort_additional_pass, cohort_gain, no_case_regression, no_critical_regression, protected_recall_not_reduced. Passing gates: baseline_identical, privacy_canary, source_drift, deterministic, provider_identity_bound, latency_within_bound (semantic p95 737.563284 ms vs baseline 704.052117 ms), abstention_not_regressed, ambiguity_not_collapsed, no_new_forbidden, channels_visible, bounded. promotion_authorized, retrieval_influence and authorizes_actions were false. The report validated against the v1 schema and contained no runtime canaries.

NOTE: Scored categories are paraphrase, synonym, ambiguity and control; negatives are excluded from gain. Protected suites are v27, challenges_v26 and ontology_cohort. no_new_forbidden is a per-case subset. Ambiguity uses found_count. Drift reuses one content-keyed memo and compares a fresh memo. Real ontology_cohort regressions were alias-retention-ledger and alias-rrf-fusion; semantic-cohort additional_pass_ids were empty and MRR/Recall gains were 0.0. Thresholds were not tuned.

MINOR: evaluate_semantic_shadow applies 1e-12 to protected_recall, per-suite negative_abstention and latency in addition to the authorized cohort_gain comparison. PROMOTION_POLICY values are unmodified; the extra epsilon cannot hide a 1-count discrete recall or abstention change.
MINOR: privacy_canary does not re-scan canonical JSON of the whole report. Query and corpus helper checks passed, and both the synthetic e2e report and the real report contained no canaries.
MINOR: most gate-failure unit tests mock _run_suite. Live retrieval, drift, privacy, digest pinning and R15 were exercised by /tmp probes and the real evaluation.
source_grounding_result: evaluate_semantic_shadow reuses ontology_eval._load_v27_cases, _load_v26, _load_cohort_document, _cohort_cases, _variant_outcome and _metric_summary. The frozen semantic cohort is digest-pinned and read-only. Drift and privacy run in temporary checkouts. Shadow outcomes use comparison pointers; baseline outcomes use retrieve_sources(influence="off").
privacy_result: Canaries are built at runtime from fragments and checked with scan_text for aws-access-key, github-token and openai-token. Query canaries raise query_privacy_refused before any recorded embed; corpus canaries fail snapshot admission. Owned files are scan_bytes-clean. The real evaluation report contained none of the runtime canaries.
retrieval_quality_result: All sixteen gates are present; status is promotable only when every gate is true. Owner thresholds are bound in PROMOTION_POLICY and the schema. A real hashed-embedding run was held for zero semantic-cohort gain, no additional scored pass, and ontology_cohort critical/recall regressions. latency_within_bound passed under R15. held is valid and is not promotion.

rollback_result: Delete palimnex/semantic_eval.py, palimnex/tests/test_semantic_eval.py, palimnex/schemas/semantic-shadow-evaluation.v1.schema.json, docs/SEMANTIC_SHADOW.md and the workstream implementation receipt. No production retrieval, configuration key, or semantic v1 helper changes to revert.
authority_result: Phase 4 evidence-only evaluation. A promotable report would still set promotion_authorized, retrieval_influence and authorizes_actions false. This review authorizes no promotion, retrieval influence, Git write, network, or live-state action.
limitations: Full unittest suite and scripts/palimnex_check.sh were not run; Unix-socket and MCP subprocess tests are delegated to the coordinator.
The real evaluation was run on an isolated /tmp copy of the working tree with PYTHONPATH pointed at that copy so concurrent core.py edits would not affect the measurement.
Coordinator edits to palimnex/core.py, docs/COMPATIBILITY.md, palimnex/CHANGELOG.md and pyproject.toml were treated as out of scope.
